user.title: Track an Entity
user.description: Choose an entity to track how long it spends in its states across multiple time frames.

data_description.entity: The entity whose state durations will be measured. One entity per tracker — point at a group helper to aggregate several.
data_description.name: A friendly name for this tracker. Leave blank to name it after the entity and mode (e.g. "Entity State Tracker - Living Room - Specific States"). This sets the device/config name; the sensor entity IDs still follow the standard naming. You can create several trackers for the same entity.

mode.title: Tracking Mode
mode.description: Pick specific states to measure, or auto-discover every state the entity reports.

menu_options.specific_states: Specific states — measure the states you choose
menu_options.all_states: All states — auto-discover a per-state breakdown

specific.title: States to Track
specific.description: Select the states to measure. You can type a custom state that isn't listed.

data_description.states: The entity states whose duration and percentage are measured (e.g. on, heat, home). Prefilled with states seen recently.
data_description.enable_compliance: Turn on to score how much of each window the entity spent in a desired target state, with an optional pass/fail threshold.

compliance.title: Which states count as compliant?
compliance.description: Compliance is scored as the percentage of each time frame the entity spent in any of the states you choose here. These states are independent of the tracked states — you can score compliance on a state you don't otherwise track (for example, track how long a diffuser is 'on', but mark 'off' as the compliant/desired state). Prefilled with your tracked states as a convenience; change it freely. You can also type a custom state that isn't listed.

data_description.target: The states that count as compliant/desired. Time spent in any of them is scored. Independent of the tracked states — pick any state the entity can be in.
data_description.target_threshold: If set, a 'Compliant' binary sensor turns on when the compliance percentage meets or exceeds this value. Leave empty to skip the threshold.

frames.title: Time Frames
frames.description: Choose which time frames to track. Long frames (30 days, month, year) won't be complete straight away: Home Assistant's recorder only keeps a few days of history, so these windows start partial and fill in day by day as the tracker records its own data. Short frames are accurate immediately.

data_description.min_state_duration: If the tracked entity flips into a state and back out again faster than this many seconds, that brief moment is ignored — its time is added to the previous state instead, and it does not count as a separate change. Use it to filter flickering or bouncing sensors. Set to 0 to count every change, however short.

error.no_states_selected: Select at least one state to track.
error.no_target_selected: Select at least one target state, or turn off compliance scoring.
error.no_frames_selected: Select at least one time frame to track.

init.title: Edit Tracker
init.description: Adjust the tracked frames and settings for this tracker. The tracked entity and mode cannot be changed — create a new tracker to change those.

data_description.target: The set of states considered compliant. Being in any one of them counts. Independent of the tracked states — pick any state the entity can be in. Only used when compliance scoring is enabled.
data_description.target_threshold: If set, a 'Compliant' binary sensor turns on when the compliance percentage meets or exceeds this value. Leave empty to skip the threshold.
data_description.min_state_duration: If the tracked entity flips into a state and back out again faster than this many seconds, that brief moment is ignored — its time is added to the previous state instead, and it does not count as a separate change. Use it to filter flickering or bouncing sensors. Set to 0 to count every change, however short.

error.no_target_selected: Select at least one target state, or turn off compliance scoring.
error.no_frames_selected: Select at least one time frame to track.

reset_ledger.name: Reset ledger
reset_ledger.description: Clear the persisted daily-bucket history for every Entity State Tracker. Long time frames rebuild from recorder data where still available. This cannot be undone.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be enabled to carry out the reset. Guards against accidental history loss.

recorder_off.title: Recorder is unavailable
recorder_off.description: Entity State Tracker relies on the recorder to compute state durations. The recorder is not available, so tracking falls back to live-only accumulation from now on and cannot backfill past history. Enable the recorder integration to restore full time-frame history.

reset_not_confirmed.message: Set confirm to true to reset the ledger. This clears persisted history and cannot be undone.
